fusions.name: Kicked-Up Venom
fusions.desc: Kicks venom across the 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 13 poison damage to everything in the cone and knocking each target back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Fatigued] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ran to Ground
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 28 poison damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every tenth of health the target still has, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Warmed by the Ride
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Blood Keeps Going
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
